QUOTE: "The automatic path never rebuilds when `matches_source` is false, because an old process running the pipeline could drop layers and re-stamp the index with the damage." Also: "| `code` | ... | No. Only restarting the MCP client clears it |"
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says a stale-code process shouldn't rebuild because it could re-stamp damage, but it never states that reads stay current because query tools open the database per call, so the read/write asymmetry is absent.
